target.title: feat(workboard): refresh Control UI from live changes
target.body:
Closes #98805

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where the Control UI Workboard could remain stale after cards changed through Gateway methods, tools, commands, separate CLI processes, or background dispatch. Freshness previously depended on manual refresh or optional timer polling, which is disabled by default.

## Why This Change Was Made

Workboard now owns one canonical mutation-notification path and reconciles commits from separate processes through its existing SQLite store. A lifecycle-owned `plugin.workboard.changed` Gateway event carries only epoch/revision invalidation facts under `operator.read`; the Control UI coalesces those facts and refetches canonical Workboard data, including reconnect, plugin reload, visibility, protected-edit, transient-failure, and stale-write recovery. Manual refresh remains; routine timer polling and its controls are removed.

The event is an invalidation hint, not a second event log or state store. Existing Workboard reads and SQLite events remain authoritative, and no card bodies are broadcast.

## User Impact

Operators with an open Workboard see card and task-ledger changes reconcile without routine polling, including mutations initiated outside the current browser process. Inactive or hidden Workboard views defer reads until active again, and editing/mutation controls stay read-only until the canonical snapshot covers the newest accepted revision.

## Evidence

- Exact AWS proof: Crabbox run `run_d8bdc039c15d`, lease `cbx_f7d3e06a60d6`, base `5bcd25f0fb6de3cc2ba6b6a7688a9361eb355143`, candidate tree `9128d294a7273c15d1f78d5147e96bc2156720d9`; `check:changed`, canonical build, plugin SDK exports, and emitted declaration checks passed; exit 0 and automatic lease release confirmed.
- Focused tests: 13 files across tooling, Gateway, plugin services, Control UI, and Workboard; 5 Vitest shards and 695 tests passed.
- Browser proof: `ui/src/ui/e2e/workboard.e2e.test.ts`; 2/2 scenarios passed on head `945d579282f3cdbd34b396fae3b1d41a3fa1513a`. Approved screenshot/video manifest will be linked here after the draft number is assigned.
- Static proof: 30 changed files format-clean; changed TypeScript lint-clean; docs MDX clean; 5,544 internal links checked with 0 broken; `git diff --check` clean.
- Review: explicit whole-branch xhigh review reported no accepted/actionable P0-P2 findings (correctness 0.93).
- iOS adjacency: the existing Workboard design/render tests passed (15 tests); this PR intentionally adds no iOS UI behavior.

### Risk and proof gaps

- Main risk is event authorization and lifecycle/revision coordination. Tests cover reserved-event guard precedence, scope revocation, plugin reload epochs, cross-process reconciliation, exact-target races, retries, visibility deferral, stale-write protection, capture races, cleanup, and no feedback loop.
- Browser proof uses the repository's mocked Gateway E2E path; Linux changed/build/export proof ran remotely on the exact candidate tree.
- Soft sequencing note: draft #98510 currently has no exact file or Gateway-event export overlap. Rebase this draft if that session-controller work lands first.
